title: The funny story of how I got big biceps
summary: How he built big biceps as an ignorant teenager training at home with one pair of adjustable dumbbells. From about 17 to 22 he did cheat curls every day as his only biceps exercise, with almost no triceps work, and reached roughly 15-16 inch arms with biceps out of proportion to the rest of the arm. Cheat curls clearly work, but he wouldn't tell a beginner to copy this.

claims.claim: He started with calisthenics only, then moved to home dumbbells because where he lived minors weren't allowed in gyms.
With one set of adjustable dumbbells he did every exercise with the same weight, knew nothing about training and copied movements he saw on TV.
Having read that the body needs only 24 hours to recover, he did the same full body workout every day.
Triceps were too heavy at his only weight, so he used light pink dumbbells or skipped them; he didn't know the triceps make up about two-thirds of the arm.
Not knowing proper form, he cheated every curl with body English, thinking more weight moved meant more growth.
From age 17 to almost 22 his only biceps exercise was daily cheat curls: no strict curls, no chin-ups, no stretch work.
His biceps grew much bigger than the rest of his arm and still are, even though he is trying to bring up his triceps.
His arm used to be skinny with a massive bulging biceps, and people asked whether he had injected something into it.
Cheat curls work: they were his only biceps movement and his arms reached about 16 inches with almost no triceps work.
He would tell a beginner to learn strict curls first, add cheat reps only later and with very low weight, and never curl every day.
Daily cheat curling should probably have caused a biceps tear or tendinitis, but he never had any biceps issue.
